name: Kingdom
overview: The kingdom described in Scripture is an everlasting dominion established by God, transcending earthly realms as Jesus declares His kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36; Psalms 145:13). Believers are called to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, assured that all other needs will be provided (Matthew 6:33). The kingdom of heaven is near and accessible, with Jesus granting authority through the keys of the kingdom to bind and loose on earth as it is in heaven (Matthew 10:7; 16:19). Furthermore, it is the Father's good pleasure to give His people the kingdom, inviting them to enter and even take it by force, emphasizing both divine grace and active pursuit (Luke 12:32).
